baseline.actual_candidate: Actual botocore StreamingBody wrapping a counted BytesIO is returned by source.get_object; a synthetic transient get_object_tagging error or operator KeyboardInterrupt exits before existing closing scope, leaving close_count0.

implementation: Acquire existing closing ownership immediately after get_object so metadata/tag retrieval and encoding are protected as well as the original temporary-file/body-read/destination-put phase. Existing request, journal, version/hash/metadata/tag verification and quiescence/capacity/preservation policies remain exact.
limits: Synchronous copy-operator resource lifetime correction using synthetic no-network provider doubles, actual SQLite Row/temporary file and botocore StreamingBody; no live FD/S3/VPS copy or data migration.
Existing closing semantics still apply: one close attempt is made; a broken native close can raise, and close success is not guaranteed.
No arbitrary process cancellation, async S3 sink change, source deletion, endpoint cutover or throughput/asymptotic claim.
